_doc: Law-abidance (PC loyalty, help 1529), Trello dCqZ3JHZ, docs/systems/LAW_ABIDANCE.md. Read only by Fenia (dreamland_fenia utils/law) through .config("fight/law"); every key has a code default there, so a new key may lag until the fight plugin reloads. Every automatic change goes through .tmp.law.change, clamped to min..max.

scaling._doc: Ethos pulls toward its own pole: an automatic gain or loss is multiplied by gain or loss percent of the character's ethos, and a scaled change never rounds to 0. off 1 is the kill switch (all scaling off). Drift and a Ruler's judge verdict are never scaled.

bands._doc: Lower edge of the two upper bands and upper edge of the three lower ones; Plain lies between citizen and shady. Newbies are always Plain.

perks._doc: pillar and citizen: discount percent inside hometown areas, shop for goods and pets, service for paid services (silver and gold, never qp). fence: what a fence pays the three lower bands over its keeper price. The lower bands' refusals are not tunable here.

fence._doc: Percent a fence pays over its keeper price, by band, still capped at the item's cost. Above Shady a fence refuses to trade.

kill._doc: A player who kills a wanted player or a thief gains gain points, once a Kyiv day per victim. Nothing for a self-kill, an NPC killer, a character of the same account or a death in a sparring area.

deeds._doc: The law's ledger of small offences and civic deeds (.tmp.law.deed). delta is the raw change before ethos scaling, cooldown the real minutes before the same kind counts again for the same player. Newbies, immortals and sparring areas are never counted.

_daily_plus_cap: All positive deeds and quest moves together add at most this many raw points a Kyiv day. The kill reward is outside the cap.

drift._doc: Once a Kyiv day the character is in the world, law-abidance moves step points toward the ethos baseline, only from the wrong side: lawful and neutral rise from below, chaotic sinks from above. Never scaled.

quests._doc: Raw law-abidance move for a completed questor quest, by quest type and then by scenario; default covers the rest of the type, 0 is no move. KillQuest is keyed by the hero's alignment at reward (evil or default). Positive moves count in the daily plus cap.

wanted_clear._doc: A wanted player's death clears the mark while their law-abidance is above the line. enabled 0: default for every ethos; 1: the line of the victim's ethos.
